summary: Small module but the essentials fire: X-Influxdb-Version fingerprint via /ping and a real SHOW DATABASES query against /query for the unauth discriminator, with a version-gated CVE-2019-20933 flag. Gaps: no SHOW USERS harvest on unauth, no 2.x /api/v2/setup onboarding-bypass probe (a well-known 2.x class of finding), and CVE-2019-20933 is version-only - no actual empty-secret JWT forge+replay verify.

findings.tier_evidence: GET /query?q=SHOW DATABASES returns 200 with results and parsed DB names - proof of read.
findings.promotion_notes: Auto-follow with SHOW USERS (surfaces usernames and admin bool), SHOW RETENTION POLICIES per db, and SELECT * FROM <db>..<m> LIMIT 20 for sample time-series values (hostnames/tokens). Publish captured usernames to the shared spray pool.
findings.tester_next_step: curl -s -G 'http://<ip>:<port>/query' --data-urlencode 'q=SHOW USERS' ; --data-urlencode 'q=SELECT * FROM <db>..<measurement> LIMIT 20' ; harvest hostnames + admin usernames.

findings.tier_evidence: Version compared to 1.7.6; the exploit path is not actually forged/replayed - purely a version-based flag.
findings.promotion_notes: Forge an HS256 JWT with an empty secret ({"username":"admin","exp":<future>}) and hit /query?q=SHOW DATABASES with Authorization: Bearer <jwt>; a 200 confirms the bypass (stdlib-only via hmac+base64url).

findings.tier_evidence: Version-only advisory bucket (defined in _NARRATIVE) - fingerprint tier.
findings.promotion_notes: 2.x has a well-known /api/v2/setup 'allowed:true' unauth-onboarding class - add a GET /api/v2/setup probe that reads {allowed:true} as a T1 verify.
findings.tester_next_step: curl -s http://<ip>:<port>/api/v2/setup - {"allowed":true} means the initial-admin creation endpoint is open (T1 verify of 2.x hijack primitive).

proposed_shared_surface_consumers: credentials.jwt (once JWT forge lands, publish forged admin bearer to the loot)
